costOnNoTask: {{cost}} of it is on no task: the synthesis, or a chat a clean retry left behind
synthesisHeld: Held until the blocked tasks are retried or given up: a report over a graph with a hole in it would read as the final one.

steps.integrationHeld: The task branches are merged into one once every task has finished.
steps.integrationNothing: No task completed on a branch of its own, so there is nothing to merge.
steps.verificationHeld: The checks run on the merged branch once it is built.
steps.verificationSkipped: The checks did not run: the graph ended before its branches were merged.
steps.pullRequestHeld: A pull request can be opened once the task branches are merged into one.
steps.synthesisWriting: The synthesis agent is writing the final report.
steps.synthesisNoReport: The synthesis ended without a report. Its chat says why.
steps.synthesisSkipped: No synthesis ran: no task completed, or the graph was stopped first.

notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong. The other orchestrations are still on the list.

merge.title: Merge
merge.armedBy: Merges with {{method}} once the host is satisfied, armed by {{who}}
merge.waitingForPipeline: {{host}} has not attached the pipeline to this commit yet. Agentry reads it again every 10 seconds.
merge.optionalChecksFailing: A check that is not required failed. You can still merge.
merge.subject: Commit subject
merge.guard: Merges commit {{head}}, the one shown here. If the branch changes first, nothing is merged.
